title.en: One-sided errors and the suspense account
title.kn: ಒಂದು ಬದಿಯ ತಪ್ಪುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ತೂಗು ಖಾತೆ

hook.en: The final accounts are due tomorrow, but the trial balance is ₹900 out. You cannot wait. You park the difference in a suspense account and keep searching.
hook.kn: ನಾಳೆ ಅಂತಿಮ ಖಾತೆಗಳು ಬೇಕು, ಆದರೆ ತಾಳೆಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ₹900 ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವಿದೆ. ಆ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವನ್ನು ತೂಗು ಖಾತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇಟ್ಟು ಹುಡುಕಾಟ ಮುಂದುವರಿಸುತ್ತೀರಿ.

objectives.en: Open a suspense account for an unexplained difference.
Rectify one-sided errors before and after the trial balance.

body.en: Before the trial balance is prepared, a one-sided error is corrected by simply debiting or crediting the affected account with an explanatory note. If the error is found after the trial balance has been prepared with a suspense account, the other side of the rectifying entry is the suspense account.

points.en: Before trial balance: correct the account directly
After trial balance: use the suspense account

narration.kn: ತಾಳೆಪಟ್ಟಿ ತಯಾರಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲು ಒಂದು ಬದಿಯ ತಪ್ಪನ್ನು ಆ ಖಾತೆಯಲ್ಲೇ ವಿವರಣೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ತಿದ್ದಬಹುದು. ತಾಳೆಪಟ್ಟಿಯ ನಂತರ ತಿದ್ದುವಾಗ ಎದುರು ಬದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ತೂಗು ಖಾತೆ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: The suspense account closes itself

say.en: The credit side was short by 900, so 900 was put on the credit side as a suspense account.
Sales book undercast by 500: credit sales 500 more; the other side is suspense.
Rent of 200 posted as 600: rent is over-debited by 400, so credit rent and debit suspense.
Debits 900 equal the credit 900. The suspense account closes with no balance.

body.en: When the trial balance does not agree and the errors cannot be found at once, the difference is placed on the shorter side in a suspense account. As each one-sided error is found, its rectifying entry passes through suspense. When all errors are rectified, the suspense account closes automatically.

points.en: Closes when all errors are rectified

narration.kn: ತಾಳೆಪಟ್ಟಿ ತಾಳೆಯಾಗದಿದ್ದರೆ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವನ್ನು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಇರುವ ಬದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ತೂಗು ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಹಾಕಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಎಲ್ಲಾ ತಪ್ಪುಗಳನ್ನು ತಿದ್ದಿದಾಗ ತೂಗು ಖಾತೆ ತಾನಾಗಿಯೇ ಮುಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ.

caption.en: The difference in the trial balance sits in suspense. Each one-sided error found reduces it; when all are found it closes.

narration.en: Move the sliders as errors are discovered and watch the suspense balance.

tryThis.en: Default values: Ashok & Co. Check the suspense closes.
Set the difference to ₹1,500. How much error is still hidden?
What does a negative balance left mean about the errors found?

problem.en: The trial balance of Ashok & Co. had its credit side short by ₹900, which was put to a suspense account. Later these errors were found: (i) the sales book was undercast by ₹500; (ii) rent of ₹200 was posted to the rent account as ₹600. Pass rectifying entries and show that suspense closes.

steps.en: Suspense opens on the credit side with ₹900.
(i) Sales credited ₹500 short: Suspense A/c Dr ₹500 To Sales A/c ₹500.
(ii) Rent debited ₹400 too much: Suspense A/c Dr ₹400 To Rent A/c ₹400.
Suspense: credit 900; debits 500 + 400 = 900. Balance nil, so the account is closed.

answer.en: Suspense Dr 500 / Sales Cr 500; Suspense Dr 400 / Rent Cr 400; suspense account closes.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. The trial balance of Ashok & Co. had its credit side short by ₹900, which was put to a suspense account. Later these errors were found: (i) the sales book was undercast by ₹500; (ii) rent of ₹200 was posted to the rent account as ₹600. Pass rectifying entries and show that suspense closes.

body.en: Put suspense on the SHORT side. While rectifying, ask: "Which account was short or excess?" Fix that account; suspense takes the other side.

narration.en: Which side does suspense go?. Put suspense on the SHORT side. While rectifying, ask: "Which account was short or excess?" Fix that account; suspense takes the other side.

mnemonic.en: Short side gets suspense; the faulty account gets fixed

narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ತಾಳೆಪಟ್ಟಿಯ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವನ್ನು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಇರುವ ಬದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ತೂಗು ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಹಾಕಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ತಾಳೆಪಟ್ಟಿಯ ನಂತರ ಸಿಕ್ಕ ಒಂದು ಬದಿಯ ತಪ್ಪುಗಳನ್ನು ತೂಗು ಖಾತೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ತಿದ್ದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಎರಡು ಬದಿಯ ತಪ್ಪುಗಳು ತೂಗು ಖಾತೆಯನ್ನು ಮುಟ್ಟುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಎಲ್ಲಾ ತಪ್ಪುಗಳನ್ನು ತಿದ್ದಿದಾಗ ತೂಗು ಖಾತೆ ಮುಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ.
